purpose: Resolve implementation-level ambiguities before any real outcome scoring.

clock.policy: Preserve raw timestamp calendar fields; do not relabel or convert to UTC for day/M15/M5 partitioning.

structural_price.PDH: maximum valid Bid of previous source-clock broker day
structural_price.PDL: minimum valid Bid of previous source-clock broker day
structural_price.ATR14: Wilder ATR14 from completed source-clock M15 Bid OHLC bars only
structural_price.M5_outside_close: completed source-clock M5 Bid close outside the breached level

spread_reference: median of strictly positive Ask-Bid spreads within the immediately preceding completed M15 bar; if unavailable score spread_quality=0

event_machine.first_out: first valid Bid tick strictly beyond PDH/PDL while no active event exists
event_machine.extreme: max Bid for upper / min Bid for lower between first_out and reclaim
event_machine.reclaim: first valid Bid tick at-or-inside the structural level after first_out
event_machine.confirmation_tick: first valid non-crossed quote at or after reclaim+20 seconds and before source-day end
event_machine.daily_event_cap: at most one completed eligible event per breached level/side/source day
event_machine.atr_snapshot: ATR14 value available at first_out is frozen for the event and its outcome.
event_machine.signal_quote_validity: Bid structure accepts Ask>=Bid; confirmation requires strictly positive spread Ask>Bid.

micro_reversal: last 32 non-zero mid-price changes ending at confirmation tick; BUY rewards positive, SELL rewards negative

outcome.entry: confirmation tick: BUY Ask / SELL Bid
outcome.exit_observation: BUY on Bid; SELL on Ask
outcome.unresolved_within_horizon: binary success=0; retained separately as unresolved
outcome.crossed_quotes: ignored for signal and cannot fill
outcome.executable_quotes: Only strictly positive-spread non-crossed quotes may trigger entry/SL/TP; zero-spread and crossed quotes cannot create fill advantage.

statistics_freeze.permutation_test: exact one-sided fixed-size label permutation / hypergeometric tail for score>=70 success count conditional on total successes
statistics_freeze.bootstrap: 10000 source-broker-day block bootstrap replicates; deterministic PRNG seed 20260914; percentile 95% CI for lift(high-score rate - all-event rate)
statistics_freeze.monotonicity: hit rate must be non-decreasing across non-empty score bins
